mapper.select:
SELECT p.place_id, p.place_api_id, p.place_name, p.place_address, p.place_lat, p.place_lng, p.place_main_image_url, p.place_type_id, p.place_location_id,
pt.place_type_name, pl.place_location_name,
ts.spot_overinfo, ts.admission_fee, ts.opening_hours, ts.contact_info, ts.parking_info, ts.rest_day
FROM tblPlace p
JOIN tblPlaceType pt ON p.place_type_id = pt.place_type_id JOIN tblPlaceLocation pl ON p.place_location_id = pl.place_location_id LEFT JOIN tblTouristSpot ts ON p.place_id = ts.place_id
WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}

mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id as "placeId", p.place_api_id as "placeApiId", p.place_name as "name", p.place_address as "address", p.place_lat as "latitude", p.place_lng as "longitude", p.place_main_image_url as "placeMainImageUrl" /* (검색 목록이므로 이 정도만 가져옴) */ FROM tblPlace p JOIN tblKeywordLink kl ON p.place_id = kl.place_id JOIN tblKeyword k ON kl.keyword_id = k.keyword_id WHERE k.keyword_name = #{keywordName} ORDER BY p.place_id DESC
